test_name: Grips disabled after leaving play with cam tools open - 3e73f715-6626-4558-ab35-69b23345a93a
summary: Aborted because I could not reproduce the problem in the editor, so I have no root cause I can trust. I opened the camera toolbox while playing a Sandbox level, then went back to edit mode through the pause menu's Edit path, both with and without the pause menu open. Both times the toolbox closed in edit mode, the game was not paused, and grabbing items in the editor stayed enabled. The editor has no VR headset, so a cause that only happens with real controllers (for example, holding grip while pointing at the toolbox) was not tested.
